capabilities: Navigate table cells with Tab, Enter, and hotkeys
Add, remove, and move rows and columns
Sort rows by a column and set column alignment
Compute spreadsheet formulas and export tables to CSV
extras: README warns the plugin is experimental and may have bugs that delete data in the current note, advising backups. Formula usage is documented in external Help Docs. Free, with optional donation links.
problem: Editing Markdown tables in Obsidian is tedious because moving between cells, keeping alignment consistent, and restructuring rows and columns require manual text edits.
summary: Markdown table editor that adds Excel-like cell navigation, auto formatting, row/column manipulation, sorting, spreadsheet formulas, and CSV export.
